Simulated Emission Spectra of Diatomic Molecules

Source: R/molecular_spectrum.R
molecular_spectrum.Rd

Simulates the emission spectrum of a diatomic molecule in local thermodynamic equilibrium, from a line list of the ExoMol database, convolved with the instrument profile, to compare with the molecular bands of a measured spectrum.

Usage

molecular_spectrum(
  molecule,
  temperature = 5000,
  wavelength,
  resolution = 0.05,
  isotopologue = NULL,
  dataset = NULL,
  units = "energy",
  lines = FALSE,
  cache = NULL,
  timeout = 300
)

Arguments

molecule

The molecule, as named by ExoMol, such as "CN", "C2", "OH" or "AlO".

temperature

The temperature, in K. Default is 5000.

wavelength

A numeric vector of length 2: the wavelength range, in nm.

resolution

The full width at half maximum of the instrument profile, in nm. Default is 0.05.

isotopologue

The isotopologue, as in the file names of ExoMol, such as "12C-14N" or "13C-14N". Default is the first one listed by ExoMol, the most abundant.

dataset

The line list, such as "MoLLIST-CN". See Details for the default.

units

The units of the intensities: "energy" (default) or "photons".

lines

A logical: return the lines instead of the convolved spectrum (FALSE, default).

cache

A directory where the files are kept between sessions. By default (NULL), the persistent cache of specProc when it is enabled (see download_cache()), or a temporary directory for the session.

timeout

The download timeout, in seconds. Default is 300.

Value

A tibble with the wavelength (nm) and the relative intensity of the spectrum, on a grid of step resolution / 10; with lines = TRUE, a tibble with one row per line: wavelength (nm), wavenumber (cm\(^{-1}\)), relative intensity, Einstein coefficient A (s\(^{-1}\)), energies E_upper and E_lower (cm\(^{-1}\)) and total angular momenta J_upper and J_lower. The molecule, isotopologue, line list, temperature and resolution are attributes.

Details

The line list (energy levels and Einstein coefficients of the rovibronic transitions) is downloaded from ExoMol. In a plasma in LTE at temperature \(T\), optically thin, the intensity of the line from the upper level \(u\) (energy \(E_u\), degeneracy \(g_u\)) to the lower level \(l\) is $$I \propto g_u A_{ul}\, \nu \exp\left(-\frac{hc E_u}{k_B T}\right)$$ in energy units (without \(\nu\) for photon counts), with the same temperature for rotation and vibration. The lines are convolved with a Gaussian profile of full width at half maximum resolution, and the spectrum is normalized to its maximum in the range.

By default, the empirical MoLLIST line list of Bernath (2020) is used when ExoMol has one for the most abundant isotopologue (CN, C2, CH, OH, NH, CaF, MgH, CaH), as they are small (about 1 MB) and their line positions accurate, and the recommended line list otherwise (AlO: 33 MB). Other line lists are much larger: hundreds of megabytes for TiO, MgO or CaO. exomol_datasets() lists the line lists of a molecule and their sizes.

The files are kept for the R session, or on disk to be reused in later sessions: in the directory cache, or in the persistent cache of specProc when it is enabled (see download_cache()), where line lists are kept until the cache is cleared. A molecule whose files are on disk needs no internet connection when isotopologue and dataset are given. Partition functions are not needed, as the spectrum is normalized. Wavelengths are in air between 200 and 2000 nm.

ExoMol data are released under the Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 license; cite ExoMol and the article of the line list (given on the ExoMol page of the data set) when you use them.

References

  • Tennyson, J., Yurchenko, S.N., et al. (2020). The 2020 release of the ExoMol database: molecular line lists for exoplanet and other hot atmospheres. Journal of Quantitative Spectroscopy and Radiative Transfer, 255:107228. https://exomol.com

  • Bernath, P.F. (2020). MoLLIST: molecular line lists, intensities and spectra. Journal of Quantitative Spectroscopy and Radiative Transfer, 240:106687.

See also

molecular_bands(), exomol_datasets()

Author

Christian L. Goueguel

Examples

# \donttest{
# needs an internet connection (about 1 MB); gives up after 20 s if ExoMol
# does not answer
cn <- try(molecular_spectrum("CN", temperature = 6000, wavelength = c(383, 389),
                              timeout = 20))
#> Downloading 12C-14N__MoLLIST-CN.states.bz2 from ExoMol.
#> Downloading 12C-14N__MoLLIST-CN.trans.bz2 from ExoMol (this may take a while for a large line list).
if (!inherits(cn, "try-error")) {
  plot(cn$wavelength, cn$intensity, type = "l", xlab = "Wavelength (nm)",
       ylab = "Relative intensity")
}

# }
